latest_teacher_action.diagnosis: The previous prompt preserved the koala count, color, and front-of-trumpets relation, but the scene description was too loose for the six trumpets and five giraffes. 'Arranged behind them' and 'to the side' encouraged partial visibility, crowding, or stylization that likely caused the trumpets to be missed entirely and the giraffes to be undercounted. The retry should use a stricter left-to-right composition with three clearly separated groups, full-body/full-object visibility, and stronger exact-count language for the failed objects.
expected_improvement: Increase trumpet detectability by making all six pink trumpets fully visible, large enough, and lined up in a separate back row behind the koalas.
Increase giraffe count accuracy by placing exactly five brown giraffes as a separate side group with all five fully visible and non-overlapping.
Preserve the already-correct four yellow koalas and the koalas-in-front-of-trumpets relation while reducing crowding across all objects.
preserve_constraints: The four yellow koalas are in front of the six pink trumpets.

previous_plan_error.details: The prior plan relied on generic grouping phrases like 'arranged behind' and 'separate visible group to the side' without forcing a simple layout, full visibility, or wide spacing. That was sufficient for the koalas but too weak for reliable counting and recognition of six trumpets and five giraffes.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Regenerate with a simple wide scene and three horizontally separated groups. Put four yellow koalas in a front row at center, six pink trumpets in a fully visible back row directly behind the koalas, and five brown giraffes in a separate row on one side. Require every object to be complete, distinct, non-overlapping, and easy to count, with explicit negatives against extra instances.
regression_risks: The stricter trumpet visibility requirement could weaken the front/behind relation if the trumpets drift too far away from the koalas; restate that the trumpets stay directly behind the koalas.
The added side group for giraffes could crowd the scene if spacing is not explicit; require wide separation between the giraffe group and the koala-trumpet groups.
Exact-count emphasis can regress the already-correct koala count if not preserved explicitly.
repair_constraints: Show exactly six pink trumpets, all six fully visible and individually separated, in one back row directly behind the four koalas.
Make the trumpets unmistakable as trumpets: six complete pink trumpet objects, not cropped, not merged, not hidden behind the koalas.
Show exactly five brown giraffes, all five fully visible as separate giraffes in one side group.
Keep every giraffe complete and non-overlapping so all five are easy to count.
Keep exactly four yellow koalas in front of the trumpets, fully visible and separate.
Do not add any extra koalas, trumpets, or giraffes.
